regions.merged_text: God bless you My Dear Rt. Rev. Brother Edward. God bless you and yours these unsettled days - at once - days of threatening forebodings and of manifestations of God's/Wisdom and Power merciful Goodness without end or & limit; the former on the part of irrelition and worldly-inclined humanity. And God help us! Who can presume to claim exemption from that stupid in- clination? . .. Hence too, our natural tendency to listen to even vain forebodings and to fear for ourselves personally as well as for crazy - be- cause sinful - humanity in general? Incidently, it was about twelve years ago that a certain (Jewish) Rabbi Rosenwasser came the Office here in the St. Bonaventure Monastery, lamenting the prevalence of atheism - most especially he stressed; " ... among the rising Jewish generation". Fr. S. politely invited him into an instruction room. Then, without a word on a piece of tissue-paper - the Rev. Rabbi's index (Unfinished Draft)
